summary: Colin Wright, based in Cambridge, UK, has a background in mathematics and programming, with expertise in languages such as C, Python, and ARM assembler. He has a strong interest in aviation, particularly in aircraft design and technology, as evidenced by his discussions on the MC-10 Cri-Cri and other aircraft. Colin is also involved in community events related to mathematics, organizing conferences like MathsJam, which focus on engaging discussions and presentations about mathematical concepts. He expresses a critical view of online discussions, particularly regarding the quality of discourse on platforms like Hacker News, and has a keen interest in the implications of privacy and identity in online interactions. Colin has a history of sharing detailed insights and critiques on various topics, including programming, education, and the impact of technology on society.
